name: Polymer Chemistry Laboratory
description: Experiments: purification of monomers; suspension, emulsion, solution and bulk polymerization; unsaturated polyester resin technology; preparation of nylon 6 and nylon 10 by interfacial polymerization; copolymerization and determination of reactivity ratios; epoxide equivalent; molecular weight determination by viscometry; atom transfer radical polymerization of styrene; thermal characterization by DSC and TGA; GPC; FTIR and NMR.
